seo.description: Learn about Urinary Tract Infection — symptoms, causes, risk factors, diagnosis, treatment options, and prevention tips.

overview: Urinary tract infection (UTI) is bacterial infection of the bladder or kidneys, very common especially in women. Prompt antibiotics and hydration prevent ascending infection and complications.
symptoms: Fever and flank pain if kidney involved
causes: E. coli from perineal flora (most common)
diagnosis: Clinical symptoms localising to bladder vs kidney
Imaging if recurrent or complicated UTI
treatment: Short-course antibiotics based on culture sensitivity
prevention: Avoid holding urine for long periods
Cranberry products may help some women (evidence modest)

faqs.question: What causes Urinary Tract Infection?
faqs.answer: Multiple factors including genetics, lifestyle, and environment contribute.

faqs.question: Is Urinary Tract Infection curable?
faqs.answer: Many conditions are manageable with proper treatment. Consult your doctor for prognosis.

emergencySigns: High fever with flank pain and vomiting
UTI symptoms in pregnancy — always seek prompt care
